name: Service Pro
summary: One-page site for a local service business: split hero with a huge headline on the left and an offset photo on the right carrying a floating hours/phone/address card, trust chips, a numbered two-column service list that expands on tap, a 4-step timeline that draws itself, a photo strip with a lightbox, hours + FAQ side by side, a full-bleed call band and a sticky Call/Text/Directions bar on phones. Feels direct, trustworthy and crafted.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: Eyebrow with the city, h1 = {{tagline}}, one-line lead, Call + See services buttons, offset hero photo with a floating info card (hours, phone, address from tokens), then a row of 4 trust chips
sections.edit: Keep one h1 (the owner's promise, under about 45 characters; longer ones get a smaller size automatically). Rewrite <title> as "Business | trade in City" (10-60 characters) and the meta description (50-160) once the trade is known. Rewrite the lead in one or two plain sentences. Trust chips must be short, true promises the owner makes (for example how quotes work, booking by text, areas served); delete any that are not true; never add numbers, years, awards, ratings or certifications

sections.name: services
sections.what: Section head + numbered editorial list (2 columns on computers). Each <details class="svc"> has a name (h3), a one-line summary and a detail paragraph that opens on tap; numbers 01, 02... count themselves
sections.edit: One <details class="svc"> per real service the owner offers; delete the rest (keep at least 3). Replace the summary and detail with the owner's words. No prices unless the owner gave them

sections.name: process
sections.what: How it works: intro, an optional 'about' photo with a name tag, and a 4-step timeline whose line fills as you scroll (cards on computers)
sections.edit: Rewrite the 4 steps to match how this business really works (3 to 5 steps are fine). Delete the <figure class="process__photo"> if there is no good photo of the owner, team or place

sections.name: gallery
sections.what: Recent work: 4 photos in a strip (swipe on phones, staggered row on computers) that open in a lightbox with the alt text as caption
sections.edit: Use real photos of the owner's work; write honest alt text, it becomes the caption. Delete the whole section if there are no real photos

sections.name: info
sections.what: Wrapper that holds two blocks side by side on computers: visit and faq
sections.edit: Keep the wrapper; delete either inner section if needed, the other fills the row

sections.name: visit
sections.what: Hours and location card: decorative map drawing, address, hours rows (app.js splits {{hours}} into rows), Get directions + Copy address buttons, phone and email
sections.edit: Usually only the tokens are needed. Delete the email line if there is no email

sections.name: faq
sections.edit: Every answer must be true for this business; rewrite with the owner's facts or delete the question. Delete the whole section if there are no facts

sections.name: cta
sections.what: Full-bleed accent band: kicker, h2, the phone number in huge type, Send a text + Directions buttons, a giant faint {{initial}} in the background
sections.edit: Rewrite the h2 as one friendly line; keep the phone link

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Brand, tagline, contact, address, hours, copyright, back to top
sections.edit: Tokens only; add a real social link only if the owner gave one

photo_slots.hint: the owner or team at work, or a striking close-up of the finished result; shown 4:5 on computers and 16:11 on tablets, cropped with object-fit
optional: the owner, the team or the front of the place
work in progress or tools of the trade
another finished job or a before/after

behaviors: sticky glass header with a call button; logo shrinks on scroll
sticky Call / Text / Directions bar on phones (sms: and Google Maps links are built in app.js from {{phone_href}} and the data-address attribute)
reveal on scroll and staggered lists (motion kit)
services and FAQ are native <details> with a smooth height transition
timeline rail fills as you scroll and lights each step
photo strip: swipe with a progress bar on phones, staggered row on computers, lightbox with arrows, swipe and Esc
opening hours text split into tidy rows
subtle parallax on the hero photo; scroll progress bar
style_notes: Works with every style; strongest with workshop-industrial, editorial-serif, dark-luxury, swiss-grid, poster-bold, retro-americana, clinical-clean. Tested at 390 and 1280 with workshop-industrial, dark-luxury, editorial-serif, soft-pastel, neo-brutalist, poster-bold, high-contrast-sport, midnight-neon and minimal-mono. Text only uses --c-ink/--c-muted on --c-bg/--c-surface and --c-on-accent on --c-accent; the accent is used for fills, lines and icons, never as text colour. Numbers on the service list, steps and photos are CSS counters, so deleting items renumbers them.
